$comment: The accessibility RATCHET, and the reason it exists.
axe was pointed at the real pages for the first time on 2026-08-04 and found violations that
predate the wave that added it: the brand amber used as TEXT measures 2.52:1 on a light
surface, and it appears ~1,842 times. That is a real defect and it is also a judgment-heavy
sweep (many of those uses are on ink bands or are icon colour, where the rule differs), so it
belongs in its own reviewed pass rather than appended to the wave that surfaced it.
Blocking on day one would have meant one of two bad outcomes: the wave stalls behind an
unrelated sweep, or somebody mutes the suite. A ratchet is the honest third option -- the
count is frozen per (surface, state), a RISE fails, and a fall is celebrated and re-frozen.
Every number here is debt with a date on it. Lower them; never raise them.
Re-freeze after a sweep with: PW_A11Y_UPDATE=1 pnpm test:e2e --grep @a11y
